transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Uh, well... I guess I've just been having some trouble keeping my head straight lately. Over the last few months, out on the road, my mind just... keeps jumping around. 

Every little CB chirp, or a fuel price sign, or just some new idea pops up and I get sidetracked. I'm starting to miss details I usually never miss. Like, uh, a client's delivery note, or forgetting who I promised to call back. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you always had trouble staying focused like this since childhood, or is this a new change for you over the past few months?

It's... well, it's newer. I've been driving a long time and never had this issue before. It started maybe... seven months ago, I think. Right around when my daughter moved back in with me. Just... trying to keep things steady at home and on the road, I guess. That's when I noticed it.
Over these past several months, how has your sleep been—are you having trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or feeling rested when you wake up?

Uh... it's fine, I guess. I don't really need much lately. 

Most nights I'm only getting maybe... three or four hours. But I'm not tired. I just wake up before daylight and... well, I feel ready to roll. I don't feel worn out at all. So I wouldn't say I'm having trouble with it.
During these past few months, have you noticed yourself feeling unusually upbeat, energetic, or 'on top of the world'—more so than your usual self?

Uh... yeah, maybe a bit. I guess I've been pretty fired up lately. Just feeling like... whatever happens, it's all gonna work out fine. 

But... I don't know. On the flip side, I've also been snapping over small stuff. Just little things around the house or out in the yard. It's... not really my usual way. But yeah, I guess you could say that.
Have you been using any substances lately—like caffeine pills, energy drinks, or other stimulants—more than usual to help you stay alert on long hauls?
No, not really. Just my usual coffee. I don't mess with pills or anything like that.
Have you ever had a period in the past—lasting two weeks or more—where you felt unusually down, low on energy, or lost interest in things you normally enjoy?
Uh... no. Can't really say I have. I mean... sure, everyone gets tired sometimes after a long haul, but... no. Not down for weeks or anything like that. I just keep working.

Before these past several months, have you ever had another period—at any time in your life—where you felt unusually energetic, elevated, or needed much less sleep than normal for several days or more?
Uh... no. Not that I remember. I mean, sometimes you get a second wind on a long route, but... nothing like what you're talking about. Just normal, mostly.
Has this heightened energy and irritability caused any serious problems—like conflicts with clients, risky decisions on the road, or trouble doing your job—that are out of the ordinary for you?

I guess... yeah, a little. It's just... I've been missing some things at work. Dispatch will tell me something, or a client, and I just... I don't track it. Have to ask them to repeat it. And I missed a couple of sales calls because my head was just... somewhere else. Too many things going on up there. And... well, at home... my wife and daughter, they're kind of tiptoeing around me. I know I'm making things tense.
Have you ever been diagnosed with or treated by a doctor for depression, mania, or any other mood problem at any point in your life before these last few months?
No. Never seen a doctor for anything like that. Just... regular checkups for the DOT physical. That's it.

Over these past several months, has this feeling of being unusually energetic or irritable been present nearly every day for at least a full week at a time, or does it come and go within just a day or two?
It's... pretty much every day. Yeah. Just kind of... always there. Has been for a while now.
I don't know... sorry, I didn't catch that. My mind was kind of wandering. What did you ask?
I'm not really sure. I haven't noticed anything like that. I mostly just... focus on getting my routes done, you know? Haven't paid much attention to it.
